info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Location Status API
info.description: The Branch Location Status API provides real-time information about the operational status of bank branches, allowing businesses and customers to check branch availability and service conditions. This API is essential for banking applications and customer service platforms that require up-to-date insights into branch operations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and banking application developers who need to integrate branch status information for enhanced customer experience and operational efficiency. By leveraging this API, users can make informed decisions about branch visits and service availability.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of branch location operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of operations specific to a branch location. It provides relevant information that can help in tracking the performance and availability of branch-related services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of branch location operations for a specific channel. Ensure that the request parameters conform to the defined schema for accurate responses.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the operation status.

GetBranchLocationStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of operations for channel-specific branch location.
